description: Adversarial Unicode & Trojan Source gatekeeper — Scans a public GitHub repo, a pull request, a unified diff or a list of files for adversarial Unicode with the 19 rules (USC001-USC019) of dcondrey/unicode-safety-check: bidi controls (Trojan Source), invisible and default-ignorable characters, variation-selector and tag-character payloads (Glassworm), private-use code points, homoglyph and mixed-script identifiers, confusable collisions, misplace

diff.description: Unified diff (git diff output). Only added lines are scanned; findings carry new-file line numbers.

files.description: Files to scan in full. Provide exactly one of files, diff, repo or prUrl; total content is capped at 1000000 characters.

path.description: Repository-relative path; its extension selects the language and the file risk level.

identifierPolicy.description: Default ascii-only: any non-ASCII identifier is flagged (USC019).

permittedScripts.description: Used with permitted-scripts. Default Latin, Common, Inherited.

prUrl.description: Alternative to files and diff: a public GitHub pull request, commit or compare URL. Only added lines are scanned.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit for repo; defaults to the default branch.

repo.description: Alternative to files and diff: a public GitHub repository, owner/repo or https://github.com/owner/repo[/tree/ref]. Read from its source archive; files are scanned shallowest first up to the character cap and the rest are listed as skipped.

scanExcluded.description: Also scan paths the upstream scanner skips (node_modules/, vendor/, dist/, build/, .lock, .min.js, images, archives). Default false.

name: unicode-safety-gate
